description: 🆕 b20-freeze-check answers one wallet; this enumerates the WHOLE list. Replays the Policy Registry's BlocklistUpdated/AllowlistUpdated events into the full membership of a B20's blocklist/allowlist: every address ever blocked or whitelisted, when, by whom, and the current member set per scope. Compliance-grade visibility no other tool provides. Pass address= (token) or policy= (registry policy ID).
